messages:
Maya (CS): FYI RadiantHealth renewal. Procurement asked for separate invoice for EU subsidiary and wants net-60. They also requested SOC2 cert and asked about key management options. Onboarding scheduled next Tue but procurement could delay. Thoughts?
Eli (AE): On the call now. Customer's procurement system shows vendor as 'Radiant Global' vs billing entity 'Radiant Health US' 12 mismatch. They prefer wire but procurement insists on PO. They said PO will come through if we can issue invoice to the EU entity name.
Priya (Finance): We can split invoices by legal entity, but need correct tax IDs for each. Net-60 is doable for existing enterprise accounts after credit check. For new terms we'd need credit review (3-5 biz days). Short path: they prepay or provide PO + credit app.
Hector (Legal): They want KMS key custody language. Our standard hosted TOS doesn't grant customer key custody. Private deployment addendum required for HSM/KMS controls + security review. That will push timeline ~2 weeks. Can we provision hosted while legal negotiates addendum?
Maya (CS): Hosted-first -> Private-later was acceptable to similar customers. @Eli check whether Radiant is OK with initial hosted while HSM addendum processes.
Eli (AE): They said staged approach acceptable if onboarding isn't blocked. I'll push to get PO to unblock and confirm EU invoice details. ETA: 24-36h for PO if legal entity mapping is provided.
Sam (Onboarding): If we do hosted start, I can provision accounts and run admin training. Need final seat list + SSO domain to set up. Also will include migration checklist for switching to Private once HSM is ready.
Priya (Finance): Minimal invoice stub for AP team to attach to PO request:

```
Bill To: Radiant Health EU
Tax ID: EU-99-888777
Invoice #: RH-2026-601
Term: 12 months
Amount: $54,000
Remit: acctspayable@redwood.ai
Note: Attach PO to remittance
```

Priya (Finance): If PO not received within 7 business days we'll require either prepayment or net-30 instead of net-60. Credit review can toggle to net-60 after approval.
Hector (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum for key custody sequencing (hosted now, HSM controls on Private later) and a redline for SOW party names. Will prepare DocuSign envelope so they can sign SOW while addendum is in review.
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/0x9b (status: sent).
Eli (AE): Heads-up: the procurement contact is linda.r@radiantglobal.com. I'll share the invoice stub and request PO + tax ID mapping.
Maya (CS): Plan: Eli to get PO + tax id mapping in 36h, Hector to send redline/addendum and DocuSign, Sam to prep hosted onboarding runbook and migration checklist. I'll monitor and warn customer about payments timeline. :spiral_calendar: 
Sam (Onboarding): I'll queue the runbook and include rollback steps for tenant export and KV transfer for private migrate.
Priya (Finance): Flag me if they insist on net-60 with no credit app; I'll start credit intake.
Maya (CS): Thanks team 12 let's sync EOD tomorrow on progress.
